content.content:
- **Now:** the same rules are scoped to `:root.nx-portal` (and `html.nx-portal[data-theme="light"]`). The class sits on `<html>`, so it still reaches modals that `createPortal` to `document.body` (the reason the anchor was on the root in the first place).
- **Who sets it:** an inline script right before `<Shell>` in `app/dashboard/layout.tsx` (before first paint), and a `useLayoutEffect` in `ShellInner` (`components/nx/Shell.tsx`) that adds it on client-side entry and removes it on exit.
- **Verified** by loading the compiled CSS from before/after dev servers into a harness with every class in the stylesheet, inside the shell and in a body-level "modal", dark and light: identical computed styles; non-portal pages unchanged.
- **Rule:** don't reintroduce `:root:has(...)` (or `html:has`/`body:has`) anywhere in global CSS.

---

## New marketing site: identity component library at /nxm (staging only) (2026-09-27)

First build step of the marketing-site overhaul. The owner picked the identity on a side-by-side board (124 candidates from the new design package, the live marketing site and the portal; spec at `/root/nxeon-marketing-v1/IDENTITY-SPEC.md`). `/nxm` is the living component library built from those picks.

- **Staging only.** `app/nxm/layout.tsx` calls `notFound()` unless `NXEON_ENV=staging` (set in staging's `.env`, absent in production), and sets `robots: noindex`. Not linked from anywhere, not in the sitemap. Owner's rule: nothing from the new site reaches production until the whole site is ready.
- **Isolated styling.** Everything is nested under the `.nxm` wrapper and every class is `nxm-` prefixed (the portal and live site already own `.btn`, `.btn-primary`, `.card`, `.glass`, `.card-glass`). `@property`/`@keyframes` are hoisted to top level (nested ones are silently dropped) and prefixed. The portal and live site are untouched: their pieces are copied in and renamed.
- **Files:** `app/nxm/aurora.css` (the package's Aurora UI CSS, generated: keyframes/@property hoisted, everything else nested under `.nxm`); `app/nxm/nxm.css` (Aurora tokens, Geist type via the root layout's `--font-nx-sans`/`--font-nx-mono`, and the ported buttons/surfaces); `app/nxm/_aurora/runtime.ts` (the package's aurora.js with every document-level query/listener rebound to the `.nxm` root); `app/nxm/_aurora/icons.ts` (Aurora's 24 icons + NX logo paths, rendered server-side); `app/nxm/_components/ReviewBadges.tsx` (real reviews only, never the live component's placeholder numbers).
- **Button hierarchy proposed:** Primary `.nxm-btn` (the live `.btn-deploy`, which the portal's `.btn` turned out to be a recoloured copy of; deploy/buy CTAs carry Aurora's animated rocket), Secondary `.nxm-glassbtn` (Aurora glass with the portal's travelling rim), Emphasised dark `.nxm-rim` (portal `.btn-primary`), Quiet `.nxm-2`/`.nxm-ghost`.
- **Moved:** the library now lives at `/nxm/library`; `/nxm` is the new homepage (below).

### New homepage at /nxm (staging only) (2026-09-27)

A faithful port of the design package's homepage (`dist/nxeon.html`), not a redraw: its own markup, CSS and script, with the owner's identity picks applied on top.

- **Generated, not hand-edited.** `python3 tools/nxm/port_home.py` reads the package's `source/part1-3.html` and writes `app/nxm/home.css` (every selector scoped to `.nxm-home`, keyframes hoisted), `app/nxm/_home/content.ts` (header + section HTML), `app/nxm/_home/script.ts` (the design script), `public/nxm/home/*` (65 images/logos, copied instead of base64-inlined) and `public/nxm/three.min.js` (self-hosted because the CSP blocks cdnjs). Re-run it after any design change; the owner's changes live in the script, so they survive a re-run.
- **Owner's changes applied by the generator:** Geist instead of Plus Jakarta/JetBrains Mono (with the hero subtitle width and final heading size adjusted so the design's line breaks hold); design buttons swapped for the library's `.nxm-btn` (rocket on deploy/start CTAs) and `.nxm-glassbtn`, with labels in `.nxm-bt` spans because the design script rewrites two of them; preview links mapped through the package's `docs/url-map.json` and `https://nxeon.cloud/` links made relative; final CTA uses the live homepage's copy over the design's cloud art; the design's `#year` lookup guarded (its footer is replaced).
- **Filled per request in `app/nxm/page.tsx`:** nav button ("Deploy a server" signed out, "Open dashboard" signed in, via `currentUser()`), real-only review badges under the hero checks (nothing renders while there are no approved reviews), and the live `MarketingFooter` inside `CurrencyProvider`.
- **Script:** `_home/HomeScript.tsx` injects the design script as a real script element after mount, so the globe, nav, wizard and game showcase run exactly as in the standalone file.
- **Staging banner:** `HomeScript` pushes the fixed nav down by however much of the in-flow SANDBOX banner is still on screen (written on the nav element only when it changes), so it never covers the nav and never leaves a gap after scrolling.
- **Signed in:** "Log in" is dropped (desktop bar and mobile sheet) and the dashboard button fills the sheet footer.
- **Performance rule: no `:root:has(...)` in marketing CSS.** Chrome re-checks a `:has()` on the root after every DOM insertion anywhere on the page, and this homepage inserts nodes constantly (orbit beams and card, globe labels, word rotator), so each insertion restyled all ~5,000 elements (50–90ms stalls, traced 2026-09-27; the owner saw it as lag when the integrations orbit first loads). The design's html/body rules are scoped to `:root.nxm-home-root`, a class `HomeScript` adds to `<html>` while the homepage is mounted. The portal's own `:root:has(.nx-shell-root)` rules in `app/globals.css` load on every page and still cause the same full restyles here (and on the live marketing pages); left untouched pending the owner's call, since the portal is off-limits for this project.
- **Verified** against `dist/nxeon.html` at 1440px and 390px: all 15 sections present in the same order, heights within a few px except where the owner's changes differ (hero pill/subtitle under Geist, the longer final CTA copy). No script errors.

---

- **Owner feedback round (2026-09-27):** review badges on every /nxm page now render the live site's badges exactly (`reviewBadgesHtml()` reuses `components/marketing/ReviewBadges.tsx`'s data: real approved reviews, else its built-in figures; `.nxm-rb` copies the live look). The homepage hero no longer has the photo backdrop (aurora/stars canvases only). The nav's top-level items use the live `.nav-underline` hover (a blue to violet line that sweeps in from the left), in `nxm.css`. A shared reassurance card (`reassuranceHtml()` in `app/nxm/_data/lib.ts`, `.nxm-assure`) sits under the /pricing panel and the /game-servers configurator.   first-month-free promo (per-customer eligible only) now follows the same pattern: headline `$0/mo`, "First month,
  then $X/mo" — replacing the mint "FREE FIRST MONTH" tag. Email has no intro pricing and is unchanged. The

  "First month free" pill on Cloud Hosting is a service tile, not a plan card, and was left as is.

  (`components/nx/useRegionLatency.ts`): once the region step is on screen, each region with a probe URL gets one
  warm-up request, then 5 timed `no-store` requests (sequential, `no-cors` + no credentials when cross-origin); the card
  shows the **median**. No probe or all samples failed → a neutral "— ms", never an estimate (`Region.ms` in

  app's own `/api/tools/ping` for the **primary node's** region (the portal is served from the primary). **fsn1 has no
  browser-reachable endpoint today** (node-2 exposes only Proxmox/node-agent on self-signed certs and NAT'd game/VM

  `savedPaymentMethod.enableRedisplay: "never"` so Stripe's element does not list saved cards a second time (the

  cyan→pink `.btn-pay`; labels, loading/disabled states unchanged, disabled buttons no longer lift/shimmer on hover.
